procedural_matters: GER 226171 was represented by Carl-Anton Stollner.
Joao Carneiro gave evidence as a witness for the International Jury.
facts: Less than one minute after the start of race 1 yellow fleet, second attempt.
GER 226171 was penalized under RRS P1.2 by jury observers.
GER 226171 then tacked, gybed and resumed racing.
GER 226171 was not previously penalized in the event.
conclusions: According to RRS P2.1, GER 226171´s appropriate penalty was a Two-Turns Penalty.
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the International Jury. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
